tasks.description: Prove native screenshot feasibility. Bounded scope: src/Gaze.App/TranscribeCaptureProbe.cs; src/Gaze.App/TranscribeScreenshotSource.cs; src/Gaze.App/Program.cs; docs/factory/evidence/capture.md. Spec mapping: AC03,AC04,AC07,AC14.
acceptanceCriteria: Create a bounded screenshot probe using existing Windows Graphics Capture for cursor-free full-window PNGs and visible-pixel rectangle capture; do not wire production controls.
Record occluded-window freshness, starting-monitor clipping, mixed DPI and UI exclusion results with OS/hardware versions in docs/factory/evidence/capture.md.
Preserve process/batch on ordinary failures; if approved capture semantics cannot be met, stop the affected dependency chain and surface the limitation.

Human-approved validation adjustment: run feasible single-monitor behavioral/native checks and required automated checks. Multi-monitor/mixed-DPI desktop checks and unavailable hardware/driver metadata are deferred, not implementation/task-completion prerequisites. Record them explicitly as untested; preserve intended behavior and do not claim they passed.

tasks.description: Prove virtual ZIP compatibility with Claude Desktop. Bounded scope: src/Gaze.App/TranscribeClipboard.cs; src/Gaze.App/Program.cs; docs/factory/evidence/clipboard.md. Spec mapping: AC11,AC13.
acceptanceCriteria: Create an in-memory virtual-file clipboard probe using Windows OLE FileGroupDescriptorW/FileContents; keep ownership on a pumping STA independent of the session window.
Validate actual Claude Desktop attachment/paste and ZIP ingestion separately, recording app/OS versions, file-write observations and clipboard lifetime in docs/factory/evidence/clipboard.md.
No image/ZIP/temp spill or disk fallback; incompatibility blocks dependent production export pending user export-design review.

tasks.description: Model retained captures and lifecycle. Bounded scope: src/Gaze.Core/TranscribeSession.cs; tests/Gaze.Tests/TranscribeChecks.cs; tests/Gaze.Tests/Program.cs. Spec mapping: AC06,AC10,AC13,AC14.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement independently testable in-memory batch states for capture, Undo, discard, finish, failed export and retry; empty finish causes no export.
Retain immutable capture bytes/title/sequence; invalid areas and recoverable failures do not increment count; Undo removes only latest retained item.
Tests cover close/quit Finish, Discard, Keep capturing and failed Finish preventing quit; document controller contracts.

tasks.description: Classify middle gestures and monitor clipping. Bounded scope: src/Gaze.Core/TranscribeGesture.cs; tests/Gaze.Tests/TranscribeChecks.cs. Spec mapping: AC03,AC04,AC05,AC06.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement pure gesture classification with Windows drag metrics supplied by adapter, title/window/monitor snapshotted at gesture start and no target lock.
Clip rectangle to starting monitor, normalize reversed drags and ignore unusable area; window click targeting remains unrestricted across monitors.
Tests cover threshold boundaries, negative coordinates, reversed drags, monitor edges and session cancellation.

tasks.description: Build ordered ZIP contents. Bounded scope: src/Gaze.Core/TranscribeArchive.cs; tests/Gaze.Tests/TranscribeArchiveChecks.cs; tests/Gaze.Tests/Program.cs. Spec mapping: AC08,AC09.
acceptanceCriteria: Produce ZIP in memory with valid PNGs in retained sequence order and instructions.txt containing all five transcription rules.
Generate unique sortable sequence/title names for repeated, empty, reserved, invalid and long titles; rectangle uses starting title.
Tests decode sample PNGs and assert archive entries, Undo ordering, sanitization and instruction content.

tasks.description: Deliver export routes and retry. Bounded scope: src/Gaze.App/TranscribeExporter.cs; src/Gaze.App/TranscribeClipboard.cs; tests/Gaze.Tests/TranscribeExportChecks.cs; tests/Gaze.Tests/Gaze.Tests.csproj; tests/Gaze.Tests/Program.cs. Spec mapping: AC10,AC11,AC12,AC13.
acceptanceCriteria: Route AutoCopy on to proven virtual ZIP publisher, off to configured folder with collision-safe creation; snapshot route at session start.
Export exceptions retain batch and expose Retry; never fall back to disk, overwrite existing files or mutate clipboard for empty batches.
Inject route failures and verify retry contains same retained ordered captures; verify clipboard ownership survives session UI disposal.
